svg.title: Mehhti — AI & Machine Learning
svg.desc: A small convolutional neural network drawn as a scientific figure: an input image, convolution and pooling feature maps, two dense layers and a softmax output, with signals flowing through the layers one at a time; each pass takes a new sample and gives its own prediction. On the left: the name, a training-loss curve, and a note that Android apps are built for fun.
svg.text: ▸ side quest: building Android apps, just for fun █
fig. 1 — signals flowing forward, layer by layer
